title: Fix an invalid field
caption: A too-long title and a malformed note reference each produce a message on the field that needs attention.

title: Require an identity
caption: Creating a note without an identity is refused. The page asks for authentication.

title: Handle storage unavailability
caption: When the store is unavailable, the app reports the outage and invites the user to retry.

title: Bound a stuck request
caption: A request that does not finish in time returns a timeout message. The form remains available for another attempt.

title: Keep internal failures private
caption: An unexpected failure gives the reviewer a correlation reference without displaying the server’s internal details.

title: Read a web note after restart
caption: After the local service restarts, the real command-line client opens the note created in the browser. A different user is still denied.

title: Use the command-line contract
caption: The CLI explains its purpose, reports a typed JSON validation error, and refuses a test identity on a remote endpoint.
